title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Smiling can help you feel revitalized. Why don't you try smiling, Doctor.

title: Talk 1
original: Rhodes Island shouldn't be like those black-hearted corporations, right? Lungmen Industrial Waste Disposal License, Lungmen City Sewage Permit... Well, it seems like there are no problems with your certification, and the sewage treatment seems good enough... It's good that you're a law-abiding organization!

title: Talk 2
original: Woah, this water tastes amazing~! It's cool and sweet, just like the springs back in my hometown... Where's the water source? How is it filtered? What are you using to filter it? Please tell me quickly, Doctor!

title: Talk 3
original: There are signs of excessive wastewater discharge this mon-- Huh? Did I take too many baths again? ...Oh no, I must reflect upon my behavior!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: I love my hometown! Although it's not as lively in the country as it is in the city, and daily life isn't as comfortable, the water there is cool and delicious, and the air is always fresh. Hehe, these are sometimes hard to come by in the city!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: The pollution near the city is getting worse and worse. Earlier, we even had problems with the water supply in my hometown, and resolving that situation required a lot of effort. While Catastrophes pose a very clear threat to us, pollution will also erode away at our habitable spaces! Therefore, protecting our environment is also of great importance!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Heave, ho! That should be the last shoe... Got it! Phew, now, this waterway will be much cleaner, and my daily efforts here won't go to waste! Thank you for accompanying me, Doctor!

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: There is a legend among my people that we came from a place far, far away. Now that there are fewer and fewer of us, nobody seems to know where we came from, or where we are going...

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Back in my hometown during harvest season, each family will make lots and lots of delicious food! Braised, sweet and sour, steamed, fried, marinated, anything you can imagine! Doctor, why don't we go visit together? The people there are very hospitable~

title: Idle
original: Ugh... So dry... I want to soak in a bath...

title: Onboard
original: Hello, I am the municipal waterway cleaner, codename Purestream! From now on, I will handle the water treatment and sanitation of this ship, so please rest assured! Oh, these are pickled vegetables from my hometown. Everyone is welcome to try some—I assure you, they're delicious!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: If the purpose is to gain experience, wouldn't it be faster to put everything into practice?

title: Promotion 1
original: Am I getting a raise? With this promotion and salary increase, I'm well on my way to the top! Hehe, I'll have to tell everyone back home the good news~

title: Promotion 2
original: While there is a difference in urgency between visible threats and less evident threats, they are both dangerous to us! I'm glad you understand, Doctor.

title: Added to Squad
original: No problem, just leave it to me!

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Such an important task... I'll do my best!

title: Depart
original: Rhodes Island Water Treatment Team, heading out!

title: Begin Operation
original: Surprise inspection! That punk just poured paint down the sink! Get him!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: A fight? Alright! Lemme Roll up my sleeves… Oh, I don't have sleeves.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Woah, they're really fighting!

title: Deployment 1
original: Cleaning work is my specialty!

title: Deployment 2
original: Water delivery!

title: In Battle 1
original: Breach and flip!

title: In Battle 2
original: That's unauthorized discharge of sewage!

title: In Battle 3
original: Water works to the benefit of all.

title: In Battle 4
original: Did that splash of cool water wake you up?

title: 4-star Result
original: No more contaminants! Very good, this mission was a great success~

title: 3-star Result
original: Operation complete! But we have to be diligent with the cleanup.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Hey, where'd the enemy run off to? I-I can't find them!

title: Operation Failure
original: The situation is looking bad, but we have nothing to fear as long as we stay strong! Let's fall back for now?

title: Assigned to Facility
original: I hope I can get a nice, big bathtub.

title: Tap
original: Hmm?

title: Trust Tap
original: Let me tell you a secret - I can swim upright!

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Doctor, Happy New Year! Mom and Dad sent me some pickles they made. I've checked the calendar, now's the best time to eat them! Quick, try some, and I'll fetch some for everyone else too. Hehe, Our village might not be famous, but even city people know this kind of pickle!

title: Greeting
original: Good morning, Doctor! Would you like a cup of cool, refreshing spring water?

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Doctor! This is a water purifier I developed myself. You connect it to the tap, and it lets you directly drink the water that comes out! Oh, of course, I'll keep working on new filter models for you to replace it with. I've got this all planned out, and the next step is—getting everyone at Rhodes Island to use it!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: I often have this sinking feeling that my own power is too little, but if I can change a company as big as Rhodes Island by myself, then there have to be more people like me across the land. As long as we all keep up our own strives, the future will be better, won't it?
